info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Users API
Users
List Intercom help-center articles under a parent collection or section

params.name: parent_id
params.description:
Intercom collection or section id to list articles for. Required —
a 400 is returned when this is missing.

params.name: state
params.description:
Filter articles by publication state. Defaults to `published` when
the parameter is omitted.

params.name: quantity
params.description:
Optional cap on the number of articles returned after filtering.
When omitted, all matching articles are returned.

items.docs:
Returns Intercom Help Center articles that live under the given `parent_id`
collection or section, optionally filtered by publication state and
capped at a maximum number of results. Results are read from a cache
backed by the Intercom Help Center API.

info.name: Mint an Intercom Messenger JWT for the caller

params.name: platform
params.description:
Which Messenger client is booting. Determines which platform-specific
Messenger secret the JWT is signed with — `INTERCOM_MESSENGER_SECRET_WEB`,
`INTERCOM_MESSENGER_SECRET_IOS`, or `INTERCOM_MESSENGER_SECRET_ANDROID`.

items.docs:
Returns a short-lived signed Intercom Messenger JWT for the authenticated
user. The token is signed with the platform-specific Messenger secret
(Intercom issues a distinct secret per web / iOS / Android client), so
the caller must declare which platform is booting via the `platform`
query parameter.

The token TTL is 10 minutes — refresh on every Messenger boot.

info.name: Attach the caller to an Intercom company

items.docs:
Attaches the authenticated user to the given Intercom company and then
refreshes their Intercom custom attributes (rentcheck/chargebee
subscription ids, company id). Both the company-attach and the user
refresh proxy through the Intercom REST API; the response payload
mirrors Intercom's responses verbatim and is intentionally untyped.

The attach step is a no-op when the caller has an internal RentCheck
email, in which case `company` is omitted / null while `user` is still
refreshed.

info.name: Register an FCM device token for the caller

items.docs:
Replaces all of the caller's registered FCM device tokens with the
supplied `fcm_token`. Used by the mobile clients on app start / push
registration.

info.name: Clear the caller's FCM device tokens

items.docs:
Removes every FCM device token registered for the caller. Used by the
mobile clients on sign-out / push unregistration.

info.name: Get the authenticated user

items.docs:
Returns the full profile document for the authenticated caller, including teams,
resolved permissions, metadata and external identity verification payloads.

info.name: Update the authenticated user

items.docs:
Partial update for the authenticated caller. Changing `email` or `password`
requires `current_password` for re-authentication. Other fields update the
caller's profile metadata in place.

info.name: Disable the authenticated user

items.docs:
Disables the authenticated caller's account. The profile is retained
for audit; the user can no longer sign in.

info.name: Mint a Firebase custom auth token for the caller

items.docs:
Returns a short-lived Firebase custom auth token the caller can exchange
for a Firebase ID token via the Firebase Auth client SDKs. Used by
embedded surfaces that need to re-authenticate the caller against
Firebase.

info.name: Get the caller's personal notifications preferences

items.docs:
Returns the per-user notifications preferences document for the
authenticated caller. Used to drive the per-user notification settings UI.

info.name: Update the caller's personal notifications preferences

items.docs:
Partial update for the caller's per-user notifications preferences. Any
combination of `inspections_awaiting_review`,
`inspections_in_revision_review`, `inspections_completed` and
`automation_failures` may be supplied; the server merges the values onto
the current document.

info.name: Get the authenticated user's settings

items.docs:
Returns the metadata document for the authenticated caller — onboarding
counters, dismiss flags, and view-mode preferences. Defaults are merged
onto any persisted values.

info.name: Update the authenticated user's settings

items.docs:
Partial update for the caller's metadata. Defaults are merged onto any
currently-persisted values before the supplied fields are written.

info.name: Get the subscription-level notifications preferences for the caller

items.docs:
Returns the subscription-level defaults that apply to every member of the
caller's subscription when no per-user override exists. Resolved from the
subscription owned by (or shared with) the caller.

info.name: Update the subscription-level notifications preferences for the caller

items.docs:
Partial update for the subscription-level notifications preferences
shared across the caller's subscription. Requires the caller to have
`allow_notifications_preferences_editing` permission on the
subscription.

info.name: Get the caller's long-lived integration token

items.docs:
Returns the caller's integration token, used for service-to-service API
calls (e.g. external integrations that authenticate as the caller). The
token is rotated by the backend when integration credentials change.

info.name: Link the authenticated user to a tenant record

items.docs:
Looks up the tenant record on the invite's inspection (or owner) that
matches the caller's email and links it to the authenticated user. If
no matching tenant exists, a new tenant + current occupancy is created
under the appropriate owner so the caller can immediately participate
in the invited inspection.

info.name: Mint a Metabase static-embedding token for Resident Insights

items.docs:
Returns a signed Metabase static-embedding JWT scoped to the caller's
subscription so the Resident Experience Insights dashboard can be
embedded in web / mobile without exposing another customer's data. The
`subscription_id` is resolved server-side and signed into the token's
locked `params`.

Access is gated to accounts enrolled in the Resident Insights beta —
non-enrolled callers get 403.

info.name: Get the caller's property manager contact info

items.docs:
Returns the contact info for the property management company that owns
the caller's tenant record. Used by renter surfaces to expose a way to
contact the PM directly.

info.name: Get the caller's pending inspection requests

items.docs:
Returns the list of inspection requests sent to the authenticated caller
that are awaiting action (e.g. additional signature requests). Used by
the apps' notification bell to surface requests the caller still needs to
respond to.

info.name: Bulk-edit users' permission groups

items.docs:
Reconciles the supplied users' permission group memberships against the supplied permission
group ids — each user is set to belong to exactly the requested permission groups (and removed
from any others on the same subscription). Returns the updated user digests.

info.name: Get all users

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search by user name, email or id.

params.name: filters[team_ids]
params.description: Filter by team ids. It accept multiple ids separated by comma.

params.name: filters[permission_group_ids]
params.description: Filter by permission group ids. It accept multiple ids separated by comma

params.name: options[pagination][page_size]
params.description: How many items to be returned for each page.

params.name: options[sort][sort_type]
params.description: Sort list in ascending or descending order.

params.name: options[sort][sort_by]
params.description: Sort list by a specific property.

items.docs: Get all users

info.name: Create a user account

items.docs:
Creates a new user account. Used by the sign-up flow. The endpoint does not require an
authenticated session — the caller authenticates the resulting user separately. If the supplied
email is malformed or looks like a typo the response will return an `email_suggestion` block
instead of creating the account.

info.name: Deactivate a user

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user to deactivate.

items.docs:
Deactivates the target user — removing them from every team and permission group on the caller's
subscription, deleting their pending team invites, and unassigning them from automations. The
caller must (a) share an active subscription with the target user and (b) be an admin of at
least one team on that subscription.

info.name: Get a user by ID

items.docs: Get a user by ID

info.name: Invite users

items.docs:
Invites one or more users by email, attaching them to the supplied teams and permission groups
with the given role. Each email is processed independently — the response groups successfully
created user digests under `success.users` and per-email failure reasons under `failure.errors`.

info.name: Update a user's team and permission group access

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of the user whose access is being updated.

items.docs:
Reconciles the target user's team memberships and permission groups against the supplied lists,
and updates the role they hold in each team. The caller must share a subscription with the
target user and be an admin on the relevant teams.
